verses.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus that are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

segments.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, to all the saints in Christ Jesus that are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

verses.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

segments.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.text: I thank my God upon all my remembrance of you,

segments.text: I thank my God upon all my remembrance of you,

verses.text: always in every supplication of mine on behalf of you all making my supplication with joy,

segments.text: always in every supplication of mine on behalf of you all making my supplication with joy,

verses.text: for your fellowship in furtherance of the gospel from the first day until now;

segments.text: for your fellowship in furtherance of the gospel from the first day until now;

verses.text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Jesus Christ:

segments.text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will perfect it until the day of Jesus Christ:

verses.text: even as it is right for me to be thus minded on behalf of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as, both in my bonds and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers with me of grace.

segments.text: even as it is right for me to be thus minded on behalf of you all, because I have you in my heart, inasmuch as, both in my bonds and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers with me of grace.

verses.text: For God is my witness, how I long after you all in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

segments.text: For God is my witness, how I long after you all in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

verses.text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;

segments.text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;

verses.text: so that ye may approve the things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and void of offence unto the day of Christ;

segments.text: so that ye may approve the things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and void of offence unto the day of Christ;

verses.text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

segments.text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

verses.text: Now I would have you know, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the progress of the gospel;

segments.text: Now I would have you know, brethren, that the things
which happened
unto me have fallen out rather unto the progress of the gospel;

verses.text: so that my bonds became manifest in Christ throughout the whole prætorian guard, and to all the rest;

segments.text: so that my bonds became manifest in Christ throughout the whole prætorian guard, and to all the rest;

verses.text: and that most of the brethren in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

segments.text: and that most of the brethren in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

verses.text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

segments.text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

verses.text: the one do it of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel;

segments.text: the one
do it
of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel;

verses.text: but the other proclaim Christ of faction, not sincerely, thinking to raise up affliction for me in my bonds.

segments.text: but the other proclaim Christ of faction, not sincerely, thinking to raise up affliction for me in my bonds.

verses.text: What then? only that in every way, whether in pretence or in truth, Christ is proclaimed; and therein I rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

segments.text: What then? only that in every way, whether in pretence or in truth, Christ is proclaimed; and therein I rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

verses.text: For I know that this shall turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

segments.text: For I know that this shall turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing shall I be put to shame, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.

segments.text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that in nothing shall I be put to shame, but
that
with all boldness, as always,
so

verses.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

segments.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

verses.text: But if to live in the flesh,—if this shall bring fruit from my work, then what I shall choose I know not.

segments.text: But if to live in the flesh,—
if
this shall bring fruit from my work, then what I shall choose I know not.

verses.text: But I am in a strait betwixt the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ; for it is very far better:

segments.text: But I am in a strait betwixt the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ; for it is very far better:

verses.text: yet to abide in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

segments.text: yet to abide in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

verses.text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide, yea, and abide with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith;

segments.text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide, yea, and abide with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith;

verses.text: that your glorying may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

segments.text: that your glorying may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

verses.text: Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ: that, whether I come and see you or be absent, I may hear of your state, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the gospel;

segments.text: Only let your manner of life be worthy of the gospel of Christ: that, whether I come and see you or be absent, I may hear of your state, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the gospel;

verses.text: and in nothing affrighted by the adversaries: which is for them an evident token of perdition, but of your salvation, and that from God;

segments.text: and in nothing affrighted by the adversaries: which is for them an evident token of perdition, but of your salvation, and that from God;

verses.text: because to you it hath been granted in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer in his behalf:

segments.text: because to you it hath been granted in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer in his behalf:

verses.text: having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

segments.text: having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
